about: Based in Colombo, Sri Lanka, my focus is strictly on building software that serves a distinct purpose. Whether it's designing a high-conversion e-commerce frontend or writing Python scripts to automate complex payroll calculations, I aim for high utility and low friction.

Currently serving as the Assistant IT Administrator for the CER Group and Technical Lead at Alpha Solutions, I have a proven track record of architecting digital identities, managing databases, and deploying internal tools that drastically cut down manual administrative hours.
I build websites, internal tools, and business systems with a strong emphasis on usability, performance, and reliability.
Web application architecture, business process automation, and UI/UX systems that support real operations.
E-commerce experiences, reporting systems, workflow automation, and tools that reduce repetitive work.
Code maintainability over shortcuts. Automate mundane tasks. Design for the end-user.

Outside engineering, I research and write, photograph and edit images, and explore visual storytelling. I am based in Kalutara and work and study in Colombo. My long-term direction is full-stack software engineering consulting.
